tools.name: record_demo_render
tools.description: Render a VHS .tape script to a publishable video (mp4/webm/gif) — deterministic terminal demos. Terminal-only recording: write a .tape describing the session (Type/Enter/Sleep/Wait+Screen /regex/), run this, get a clean video. The tape's Output path is relative to outdir, so use a bare filename there. Requires vhs + ttyd + chromium + ffmpeg (all system-installed).

outdir.description: Absolute directory to run vhs from; the tape's Output file lands here.

tools.name: record_screen
tools.description: Drive live screen recording (wl-screenrec, chunked for clean pause/resume). Use for GUI/desktop demos, not terminal-only ones (use record_demo_render for those). Actions: start-video (silent), start-internal (+desktop audio), start-mic (+microphone), pause (clean chunk boundary, no timeline gap), stop (ffmpeg-concat chunks -> ~/Videos/rec-*.mp4). Keyboard binds mirror this: Super+R/W/T start, Super+P pause/resume, Super+S stop.

commands.command: case "UTCP_ARG_action_UTCP_END" in start-video) ~/NixOSenv/scripts/record.sh toggle video;; start-internal) ~/NixOSenv/scripts/record.sh toggle internal;; start-mic) ~/NixOSenv/scripts/record.sh toggle mic;; pause) ~/NixOSenv/scripts/record.sh toggle-pause;; stop) ~/NixOSenv/scripts/record.sh stop;; esac
